cues: Six that Nepali candidates often reverse.
Not do a mistake, but make a mistake.
Not give an exam, but take an exam.
Not do a decision, but make one.
Not say a lie, but tell a lie.
Not open the light, but turn on the light.
And not strong rain, but heavy rain.
